correctness.rationale: The geometric sum is a valid closed expression for every N>=2, r>0 not 1. The only zeros are k=N/2 and odd modulation when N is even. The standard Weyl diagonalization gives a Hermitian kernel consisting exactly of imaginary antipodal cross terms. The nonantipodal support graph is connected for every support of size >=3, giving an exact fiber classification. The single extra probe determines the missing imaginary correlation. Exact arithmetic verified the sum identity and zero pattern for every N=2..12, and explicit two-sparse pairs were checked through N=10. Numerical tests are corroboration, not infinite proofs.
